exact_statement: For each fixed HI task i and each admissible recurring job index q in N, assume sporadic release separation, fixed-priority interference accounting, and a release-fixed mapping that preserves carry-in and earlier same-task demand. Then the canonical release-fixed critical-instant window for task i,q has workload no smaller than the corresponding admissible recurring-job window, so its response bound dominates that job.
conclusion: the canonical task-local critical-instant window dominates every admissible recurring job J_{i,q}
